journal_lines: Sword made of something old. Didn't let it land.
Deep place for a thing like this.
Three of them guarding the corridor.
Faster than a regular skeleton. Noted.
The sword was stone, not iron. Still heavy.
Kept moving through the wither. Painful. Manageable.
Long reach on the sword. Stayed close instead of distant.
One had a bow. Addressed that one first.
The basalt hallway was narrow. Advantageous.
Took the hit and returned twice as much.
Wither skulls in the shadows. The ground was cluttered.
The effect worked quickly. Found a way to end the encounter faster.
Black smoke rising from it when it fell.
